description: SaveResult is the answer to a save.

saved.description: Saved is false when the file changed on disk since the page last read it; nothing was written and Document is what is on disk now.

document.description: Document is the state after the save, or the state that refused it.

path.description: Path is the absolute path of the pipeline file.

yaml.description: YAML is the file's text, exactly as it is on disk.

layout.description: Layout is every node placement the sidecar holds.

items.description: Placement is where one node sits on the canvas.

id.description: ID is the node's id in the pipeline.

x.description: X is the left edge, in canvas units.

y.description: Y is the top edge, in canvas units.

w.description: W is the width; zero means the page decides.

h.description: H is the height; zero means the page decides.

has_layout.description: HasLayout reports whether a layout sidecar exists beside the pipeline.

version.description: Version identifies this state of the two files. A save must quote it.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics are the lint findings, the same ones `gimble validate` prints.

rule.description: Rule names the lint rule that fired.

severity.description: Severity is error, warning, or info.

node_id.description: NodeID is the node the finding belongs to, or empty.

edge.description: Edge is the authored edge the finding belongs to, as from and to, or empty.

fix.description: Fix suggests what to change, or is empty.

parse_error.description: ParseError is set when the file does not parse; Diagnostics is empty then.

models.description: Models says which model each node resolved to.

items.description: ModelResolution says which model a node resolved to and why.
